content: Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is a specialized high-tech chemical enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and application of cyclodextrin and its derivatives. Located in the strategically important Boxing Economic Development Zone in Binzhou City, Shandong Province—China’s cradle of fine chemical innovation—the company leverages regional industrial synergies, robust infrastructure, and a highly skilled talent pool to advance sustainable, science-driven manufacturing. Founded with a mission to bridge cutting-edge carbohydrate chemistry with real-world industrial needs, Huike has built a modern GMP-compliant production facility equipped with advanced enzymatic synthesis, precise purification, and rigorous quality control systems. Its portfolio spans α-, β-, and γ-cyclodextrins, as well as functionalized derivatives—including hydroxypropyl-, methylated, and sulfobutylether variants—serving diverse sectors such as pharmaceuticals (excipients and drug delivery enhancers), food & nutraceuticals (flavor encapsulation, stability improvement), cosmetics (active ingredient stabilization), and environmental technology (pollutant adsorption and remediation). Committed to green chemistry, the company implements energy-efficient processes, waste-minimization strategies, and strict adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 22000, and cGMP standards. With a strong R&D team comprising PhD-level carbohydrate chemists and process engineers, Huike actively collaborates with universities and research institutes, holding multiple national patents and certifications. As a trusted OEM/ODM partner for global clients, the company exemplifies China’s growing leadership in high-value specialty biochemicals—combining technical excellence, regulatory diligence, and unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and innovation.
